VAR-age.why: HM04 is a continuous whole-number variable with range 0-99, consistent with age in years (t20).

VAR-agecat.why: No separate age-category variable located; HM04 appears to be age in years and could be categorized for age groups (t20).

VAR-childmth.why: No child-months variable located; HM04 appears to be age in years and could support deriving under-5 age measures if months are not separately collected (t20).

VAR-childyr.why: HM04 appears to be age in years (0-99), suitable for child age in years when restricted to under-5 (t20).

VAR-male.why: HM03 is labelled Male/Female with codes 1/2, suitable for sex of household member (t19).

VAR-relationcs.why: HM02 codes are relationship-to-head categories (Head, Spouse, children, grandchild, other relative, non-relative, etc.) (t21).

VAR-relationharm.why: Harmonized relationship-to-head (relationharm) is typically derived from country-specific relationship codes; HM02 is the relationship-to-head variable (t21).

notes: Most columns have empty labels/questions; only a few rec02 HMxx variables expose value labels (relationship, sex, marital). Education, schooling, literacy, language, and disability sources were not identifiable from available metadata.
